verdict: Ads have been dark since September 17 — restart is the immediate priority.
narrative: All paid activity stopped on September 17, meaning you have had zero new leads from ads for 22 consecutive days. The 20 leads and $412 in spend reflected in the 28-day totals all came before that cutoff. Eight agreed project milestones — including landing pages, conversion tracking, and CRM automation — are overdue and are the direct blocker to restarting campaigns; those are being worked through now in sequence. Google Ads is paused from active optimization until conversion tracking is live, so no further spend is running there without a measurable return. Once the outstanding milestones are cleared, ads will restart with proper tracking in place, and you should see lead volume resume within the first week of that restart.
